lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Here it is! Fish Co. said we can use the townhouse for everyone we've brought back.

lines: So this is where all your fish friends live?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, everyone's got their own room. You can have one too.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah. You should have somewhere that's yours.

lines: Huh. Guess that's not so bad.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll show you which room is yours. You can settle in whenever you're ready.

lines: Don't go thinking I'll just sit around in there all day.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I was hoping you'd come diving with me again, actually.
